publication_facing_summary: A single-row metadata exposure occurred before donor aggregation or inferential testing.
One Type value, one disease value and 14 other prohibited values were viewed within one event; exposed row content is not reproduced.
The affected preparation attempt was terminated and excluded.
No program, threshold, score, aggregation, model, multiplicity or classification rule changed.
Recovery was limited to parser behavior and added no new exposure event.
Five earlier exposure events plus the affected event produced a cumulative count of six.
Subsequent support is described as restricted held-out validation.
Predefined specifications, immutable result records and independent integrity checks were retained.
